# Mr.Helper

> Mr.Helper is a home services and local services app for Warangal, Hanamkonda, Kazipet and Hyderabad in Telangana, India. It connects users with local professionals for electrician, plumber, carpenter, painting, AC repair, cleaning, labour, tuition, beauty and packers and movers services.

## About
Mr.Helper was created to bridge the gap between skilled local service providers and households in need. The platform focuses on Trust, Location-based matching, and Verification. Every provider undergoes KYC verification and admin approval.

## Founded
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Warangal, Telangana, India
- Founders: Karthik (CEO), Vamshi Krishna (CFO), Sai Harshith Goud (COO)

## Services Offered
- Electrician: wiring, switches, fans, lights, appliance installation, electrical repair
- Plumber: tap repair, pipe work, leakage fixes, fittings, bathroom plumbing
- Carpenter: furniture repair, assembly, installation, woodwork
- Painter: interior and exterior wall painting
- AC Repair: AC servicing, repair, installation, maintenance
- Cleaning: regular home cleaning, deep cleaning
- Labour: loading, unloading, shifting help, everyday labour
- Packers & Movers / Transportation: moving and local transport support
- Beauty Services: local beauty professionals
- Tuition (Hourly): hourly tuition teachers

## Service Areas (Telangana)
- Warangal (WGL): https://mr-helper-services.onrender.com/warangal/
- Hanamkonda (also spelled Hanamakonda / Hanumakonda): https://mr-helper-services.onrender.com/hanamkonda/
- Kazipet: https://mr-helper-services.onrender.com/kazipet/
- Hyderabad (HYD): https://mr-helper-services.onrender.com/hyderabad/
- Expanding to Bangalore, Chennai and other Indian cities
